recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. If maintainers want explicit source comments about keeping workflow lists and implementation pages aligned, handle that separately as source-maintenance cleanup rather than as a required FHIR-14387 specification fix.
issue_request: FHIR-14387 was a Published FHIR-I STU3 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked that the Definition, Request, and Event workflow logical model examples tabs provide tables of resources aligned with each pattern, linking each resource, its mappings tab at the workflow pattern, and its examples tab; the resolution also suggested maintenance comments.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 13126, now git commit cb743bb9269c77eca50fc806951d33b9d465982f. That commit changed the logical examples template and publisher behavior from examples to implementation lists and generated rows from workflow mappings.
additional_context: The current checkout keeps the relevant template behavior in tools/templates/template-logical-examples.html via the Implementations heading and <%lmimplementations%> include. Definition, Event, and Request remain active logical models in source/fhir.ini and in the Workflow hierarchy. The current CI pages for definition, request, and event implementations render implementation tables with resource, workflow mapping, and examples links. Community and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source and generated publication surface already provide the implementer-facing behavior requested by the tracker. Adding redundant source-only maintenance comments now would not change the built specification and would be a low-value maintenance cleanup rather than a necessary source correction.
